notes.title: Playtest over (but you can join our discord to playtest!)
notes.content:
Hi!
We've removed the playtest feature on the steam page for now. You can still playtest by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/hGNTgSAbxn]discord[/url]! In the meanwhile please wishlist Gun and Buckler, as that will help us get visibility on Steam!
